responsibilities_block: Inspect, repair, and maintain signals, switch machines, and point-operating mechanisms.
Inspect and adjust switch fit, opening, and indication gaps.
Test the electrical performance of track circuits and signal interlocking systems.
Support interlocking tests and equipment replacement during maintenance windows.
Handle signal faults, identify hazards, and complete maintenance records.
Coordinate with dispatch and track maintenance to maintain safe connections between construction and train operations.
page.work_context_block: Work follows maintenance windows. During the day, review records, prepare materials, and inspect indoor equipment. Dawn often arrives before the task ends.

page.work_context_block: Morning meetings review the previous day's fulfillment and today's peaks, followed by vehicle and warehouse scheduling.
